name: Pennyrile Energy Corridor pipeline

values.StartLocation: ANR Pipeline trunk line near Lamasco

researcher_notes: A city-formed agency in Todd County, Kentucky (Pennyrile Regional Energy Agency) is building a 53 mile, 16 inch gas line from the ANR trunk line near Lamasco to Guthrie, mostly along Interstate 24, through Lyon, Caldwell, Trigg, Christian and Todd counties. Concrete steps: a  million state appropriation in 2022, a letter of intent with Fort Campbell, right-of-way purchases and eminent domain suits against landowners, and a court dispute with the Kentucky Public Service Commission over regulation. A March 2026 Kentucky Lantern story carried by WKMS says the line has not been built and had unforeseen delays. Status set to proposed because no source confirms construction started. Cost is the reported range of  million to  million; midpoint 135 million entered, to be checked. Diameter 16 inch comes from a Herald-Ledger article (a 2024 or 2025 story); the Paducah Sun copy of it returned an error when checked, so it was not cited. An intrastate municipal line, so it is not in FERC or EIA data; no state regulator document was found. Owner not in the gazetteer, new entity written in plain agency style. ProposalYear 2022 is when the plan was announced. No route file found; route unverified. Length 53 mi is about 85 km, above the 25 km threshold. Not an existing row: no Kentucky ANR or Todd County row in the roster. Two independent news outlets agree on 53 miles; the 16 inch figure rests on one source.
